source_attribution_original: From Ælfric’s Homilies, vol. 2, pp. 106–108; being a paraphrase of Matt. 25:31–46.
locator_convention: Selected registered PDF, one-based. Prose lines1–7 are editorial counts; printed marginal5 anchors line5. Last selected sentence ends partway through printed/editorial line7, before Ðonne cwīð se.

editorial_lines.text: Witodlice Mannes Bearn cymð on his mægenðrymme,
and ealle ęnglas samod mid him tō ðǣm miclan dōme.
Ðonne sitt hē on ðǣm setle his mægenðrymnesse, and
bēoð gegaderode ætforan him ealle ðēoda, and hē tōscǣt
hīe on twā, swā-swā scēaphierde tōscǣt scēap fram
gātum. Ðonne gelōgað hē ðā scēap on his swīðran
hand, and ðā gǣt on his winstran.
